summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper, using only os and json (plus collections.abc.Mapping). Exported it explicitly in monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities block. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs removed in finally). Per instructions, I did not run tests, install packages, or commit. Line lengths were checked by measurement only; black was not run. Judgment calls: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON raises ValueError; json/unicode errors propagate as ValueError subclasses.
